paragraphs.text: Tempé was a planeswalker who marooned her sangrazul servant Malvos on the plane of Cridhe and indirectly caused a Dark Age on that plane.

Tempé is known for her manipulative sensuality and cold ruthlessness, copper red hair, red lips, and striking looks. Like Malvos, she wears silks. She closely guards her mana lines, using Sangrazul companions to find them. She finds herself in a rivalry with several others: Platon , Krim , and most notably a figure known as the Thorn , from whom she won the sword Soulslayer in a duel. It was suggested that the Thorn and Tempé are in conflict and that perhaps the Thorn had gained the upper hand as of the Mending of the Clan Tree .
